title: Junior Product Designer
note: Furniture and lighting CAD/rendering role; open to 0–3 years including internships.

facts.summary: Junior designer for a luxury home furnishings and lighting brand.
facts.duties: Build 3D models, KeyShot renderings and technical drawing packages for overseas vendors; join sample and line reviews.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in industrial, product or furniture design or related; 0–3 years experience incl. internships; AutoCAD, SolidWorks, KeyShot, Adobe; portfolio required.
facts.apply: Apply on the Arteriors iCIMS careers site.
